name: rustfs
description: RustFS fleet view: health, buckets and replication state (target online/offline, downtime, queue, failures) for every configured RustFS server, plus `who` — which agent session set up a local RustFS, from where, and when (via relic).
author: nexus-oracle

cli.help: maw rustfs <targets|status [NAME]|buckets NAME|repl NAME [BUCKET]|who [PORT]> [--json] — read-only. Targets come from ~/.config/maw-rustfs/targets.json; keys are read from pass or env, never printed.
